patientInfo.heading: For Our Patients
patientInfo.sub: What to expect as a patient at Alamin Clinic.
rights: Respectful, quality care regardless of background
Privacy and confidentiality of your medical records
Clear information about your diagnosis, treatment options, and costs before treatment
The right to request a second opinion
Access to your own medical records on request
The right to raise a concern without fear of it affecting your care
insurance: We work with major Saudi insurance providers — contact us to confirm your coverage before your visit
Cash and card payments accepted at all branches and pharmacies
Itemized invoices provided for insurance claims and out-of-pocket payments
Payment plans available for select treatments — ask our front desk
